title: GTA 6 has hurricanes and 170+ animal species 🌀
subject: gta6
description:
Which animal do you want to find first? 👇

Game Informer's GTA 6 cover story revealed dynamic weather with tropical storms and hurricanes, an upgraded wind system and more than 170 animal species across Leonida. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: Game Informer cover story (Sept 29, 2026), IBTimes UK
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: In a new 14-page Game Informer cover story, Rockstar revealed local, dynamic weather, from tropical storms all the way up to hurricanes.
The wind got a huge upgrade too, with sea breezes and buildings that actually block it.
And Leonida is packed with more than 170 animal species, from flamingos and manatees to alligators and wild monkeys.
Some are rare, some are even legendary, and they all arrive with the hurricanes on November 19.
